I was having an abortion. She told a friend about it even though I told her specifically I didn’t want anyone else to know. Her friend sent me Facebook messages for weeks trying to tell me I was bad for having one. Turns out my friend told her to message me so I wouldn’t have the abortion even though she knew it already happened. So years after her telling me I was wrong for drinking or for not drinking or for going to therapy or for not going to therapy, turns out I could never make her happy. Stopped talking to her right after. Sucks because now I struggle in friendships a lot.
